mechanism: Voriconazole inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes lisdexamfetamine to its active form d-amphetamine, potentially increasing amphetamine exposure and sympathomimetic effects.
action: Monitor for increased amphetamine-related adverse effects (tachycardia, hypertension, tremor, insomnia); consider dose reduction of lisdexamfetamine if symptoms emerge during concurrent use.
